title: Steepening of the 820 μm continuum surface brightness profile signals dust evolution in TW Hydrae's disk
question: What is the radial surface-brightness profile and dust surface density of the 820 um continuum in TW Hya's disk, and does it show signatures of grain growth and drift?

what.value: Midplane temperature profile (q0=2.6, q1=0.26, R0=7 au)

evidence.quote: We follow the midplane temperature as calculated by Andrews et al. (2012), which reproduces the observed SED.

what.value: Dust opacity 3.4 cm2/g at 365.5 GHz and Sigma_10au = 0.39 g/cm2

evidence.quote: we adopt the same value as employed by Andrews et al. (2012), $\kappa_{365.5}=3.4$ cm$^2$ g$^{-1}$ (dust).

what.value: Position angle 155 deg and inclination 6 deg

evidence.quote: Adopting a position angle for the (projected) disk’s major axis of $155^\circ$ (east of north) and an inclination of $+6^\circ$ (cite: qi2013; rosenfeld2012)

recipe.method: Verify calibration, iterative self-calibration down to 60 s
Average real and imaginary visibilities in 41 radial bins of deprojected baseline length

recipe.goal: Fit parametrized disk models to binned real visibilities
recipe.method: Model intensity I=B(T)(1-exp(-tau)), Hankel transform by summation with 0.1 au step; single and broken power-law Sigma(R)
key_parameters: 4 or 6 free parameters; fixed Sigma_10au=0.39, kappa=3.4, q0=2.6, q1=0.26, R0=7 au
assumptions: Constant dust opacity 3.4 cm2/g; geometrically thin, vertically isothermal; cos i ~ 1

recipe.method: Add Gaussian gap at 20 au to the two-slope model; scan widths and depths, reoptimize other parameters; exclude models with chi2 increase by factor two
assumptions: Gap width of 5 Hill radii for planet mass conversion

answer_key.quantity: Single power law p0 and Rout

evidence.quote: ($p_0=0.70\pm 0.01$ vs 0.75) and outer radius ($R_{\rm out}=55.7\pm 0.1$ au vs 60 au
The optical depth drops from 2.1 at 4.1 au to 0.57 at 47 au
models with gaps that are entirely empty with FWHM widths of more than 6.6 au
Integrated fluxes of 1.7 Jy (340.S) and 1.3 Jy (399.S) are found.

not_stated_but_needed: Imaging/cleaning parameters (cell, image size, masking) for Fig. 1
Line-free channel selection and spectral windows used for continuum
Self-calibration intermediate solints and reference antenna
MCMC settings: number of walkers, steps, burn-in, priors
